summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from International General Insurance Holdings Ltd. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on August 4, 2026. Shareholders voted on two routine matters: election of director Michael Gray and re-appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as independent auditor. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or capital return is described. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no material transaction or strategic action. It does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
